{{Quote|When you need crazy&mdash;''"<br />"''&mdash;call a Barabel.|Han and Allana Solo|<ref name="FotJA">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
'''Barabels''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] cold-blooded reptilians native to the dark, murky [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]. A highly aggressive and territorial species, Barabel who traveled off their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] often found work as fringers or soldiers.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|On Nal Hutta, the Vong are invaderz. What doez one call them on Barab?"<br />"Prey?|[[Tesar Sebatyne]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Barabel-EotECR.png|thumb|left|180px|A Barabel enforcer]]
Barabels were a bipedal race of reptilians who were covered in very tough, dark-colored [[Keratin/Legends|keratin]] scales.<ref name="GatORW" /> The Barabels evolved from nocturnal lizards and adapted a thick layer of fat which allowed them to retain their body temperature when temperatures dropped, and it provided some resistance to electrical shocks. Any [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] regardless of strength set on stun or lethal would not damage them at all or slow them down, even if aimed at their face, as it would merely bounce off their scales. Even close-range explosions did little to slow a Barabel, knocking them to the ground at most. Barabels were able to shed their tails if necessary, an ability that proved the undoing of many startled foes. They also possessed heavy retractable claws along with needle-sharp teeth which could grow to 5 centimeters in length. Although resistant to disease, Barabels carried lots of dangerous bacteria in their mouths. This could cause terrible infections and even death if a bite wound from a Barabel was not treated. A Barabel was capable of chomping through flesh and bone, even plastoid. A carnivorous species, Barabels possessed two [[Stomach/Legends|stomachs]] in order to process the massive amount of food they required to survive.<ref name="UAA" /> Barabels also possessed extreme strength and a powerful sense of smell. Barabels also had regenerative properties, being able to regrow lost limbs, teeth, claws, scales, and their tail.

Due to their cave-dwelling lifestyles, Barabels were able to contort their bodies in ways that would cripple an ordinary humanoid.

For breeding, Barabels devised a system in which the nest eggs of two females were fertilized by two males. Subsequently, the four individuals protected the nest. As fathers would end up not knowing which of the offspring were their own, Barabel [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] took the surname of their mothers.<ref name="FotJC">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Barabels are pretty good at thinning out vermin.|Han Solo|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
<div style="float:right">[[File:BarabelHunter-TCGTSS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Barabel hunter]]</div>
Living in low-tech communities ranging from a few dozen individuals to no more than ten thousand, the Barabel community would be built around a warren where the group thrived and hunted from. The Barabel species was noted for its hunting and tracking prowess. This was because many of their actions were fueled by their hunting instincts, leading to the general feeling that Barabels were always angry, or at least ornery. They were well known for their aggression but were also extremely loyal to their mates and parents. They greatly respected the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], because of their first experiences with a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who settled a dangerous clan dispute. Apologies, whether for a misdeed or in sympathy, were an unknown concept to Barabels. It was considered mildly insulting to a Barabel to be apologized to, and apologizing tended to make a situation worse. This sometimes was disconcerting for members of other species, especially [[Human/Legends|Humans]], who were more ruled by emotions such as guilt or sympathy.<ref name="UAA" /> Barabels also found the term "shorttail" a grievous insult, and the response was usually a violent one. Had [[Saba Sebatyne]] not been a Jedi Master, she would have slashed off the arm of a [[Yaka]] who called her shorttail and beaten him in the head with it.<ref name="FotJA" />

Barabels had a native [[Barabel (language)|language]], though they also expressed emotion&mdash;such as amusement or grief&mdash;by "sissing." They were a communal race, with separate tribes on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] numbering up to 10,000 individuals under the guidance of a pack leader. Unlike Humans, Barabels were much closer to the subconscious parts of their brains than other species.<ref name="UAA" /> Lone Barabels tended to refer to themselves as "this one" instead of typical first-person pronouns. Some common Barabel names were Ragath, Vangar, Tesar, Saba, Zal and Zozoped.<ref name="UAA" />

The Barabels had a rich mythology which revolved around a historic landing of a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] early in their history. Worshiping the Jedi as gods, the Barabel mythology revered these "warriors from beyond the clouds."<ref name="UAA" /> Among Barabel beliefs were a group of demons called the [[Blight of Barabel]]. Their names were often used as curses.

==History==
{{Quote|You know what they say: If you're captured by Barabels, don't let them give you to the females.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire: Evolution">''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire: Evolution]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Barabel-AA.png|thumb|left|180px|A Barabel with a war hammer]]
According to Barabel legend, a small group of Jedi, led by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Noga-ta]], came to Barab I some centuries before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In Barabel culture, they called these Jedi ''great warriors from the sky''. Noga-ta helped settle the [[Barabel War]], which had threatened to engulf their world in warfare. Consequently, the Barabels held Jedi in high esteem and would accept a Jedi's judgment in any dispute.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

After this contact with the Jedi, the Barabels had little contact with other species for centuries, though some had made their way off-world and had created a settlement on [[Abraxin]] circa [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> It wasn't until the rise of the Galactic Empire that Barab I received renewed attention. [[Planetary Safaris Inc.]] organized hunting trips to the Barabel homeworld, with the quarry being the Barabels themselves. After a few Barabels were killed, a Barabel leader named [[Shaka-ka]] organized groups of her fellow hunters into armies which overwhelmed the safari ships. When an Imperial investigation led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Osted Alater]] revealed that the Barabels were indeed [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], the safaris were ended. Shaka-ka formed an alliance with Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Paro Lanto]] and had the spaceport city of [[Alater-ka]] built in Alater's honor. Some Barabels began to travel offworld, working as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Some Barabels were captured by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], but more often than not, those who purchased and used Barabels would find themselves at the mercy of their new slave's claws.<ref name="FHI">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>

Later, during the days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], several Barabels became part of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. The most prominent of these was Saba Sebatyne, who went on to earn a seat on the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] and later served as interim [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]]. The Barabels were nearly wiped out when Barab I was ravaged by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during [[Yuuzhan Vong War|their invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, some Barabels escaped the widespread fires by retreating into Barab I's vast network of caverns.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Barabels in the galaxy==
[[File:Dont_shoot_the_barabel.jpg|thumb|Barabels were physically powerful.]]
While most Barabels remained on their homeworld during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] due to their relative obscurity and their dearth of available [[Starship/Legends|starships]], some Barabels had escaped their world and reached the Republic. [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Fivvic]] served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fighting alongside [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] whom he highly respected.<ref name="CS">{{InsiderCite|issue1=76|issue2=77|Changing Seasons}}</ref>

Despite finding their way to some honorable positions, most Barabels became pirates or mercenaries. One famed Barabel bounty hunter active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was [[Skahtul]], who notably captured [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SOTE" /> Concurrently, [[Tull Raine]] rose to widespread popularity as a [[Shockboxing/Legends|shock boxer]] who held the championship title for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] for years.<ref name="FOI">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> Barabels were frequent shockboxing participants and were known to be exceptionally suited to the sport.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

While [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Barabels were rare, a group of Forceful individuals that contained Barabels were active during the time of the New Republic. Under the command of Saba Sebatyne, these so-called [[Wild Knights]] rose to notoriety during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and later became a strong part of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="SBS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> Sebatyne later ascended to a seat on the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] and served as interim Grand Master following the death of Jedi Master [[Kenth Hamner]].<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Another notable Force-sensitive member of the species was Master [[Thared]]<ref name="Legacy 18">[[Legacy (2013) 18|''Legacy'' (2013) 18]]</ref> of the [[Imperial Knight]]s who fought alongside [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Marasiah Fel]] at the [[battle of the Floating World]].
